text:
maya_k: Quick sync — PolarisHealth onboarding hit two issues during private deployment smoke tests this morning: VPC endpoint policy blocking S3 PutObject for audit delivery, and KMS alias on their key doesn't match the alias our ingest expects (alias/redwood/audit). They want an ETA because audit evidence is required for their compliance signoff.

samir_cs: Oof. They also mentioned renewals team is monitoring this as a gating item. We should give a conservative ETA but push for resolution today. Can ops own the VPC endpoint fix?

diana_netops: On it. I can update the endpoint policy to allow the s3:PutObject for the CloudTrail principal from their account, and add an explicit VPC endpoint policy exception for the audit-bucket. Will test with a pre-signed put to confirm. ETA ~20m.

carlos_se: For KMS, their alias is alias/phealth-audit-key. Our ingest code expects alias/redwood/audit to resolve to the CMK. Two options: create an alias alias/redwood/audit that points to their CMK (requires their consent + IAM), or update our ingest role to reference the actual key ARN. Which do we prefer?

ivy_security: Prefer updating our ingest role to reference key ARN and use least privilege. Creating a new alias in their account is messy for BYOK and rotation semantics. Also need to ensure any change logs are captured and we have their written consent. Create CS ticket CS-4620 for approvals.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-4620 created by ivy_security. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4620

maya_k: Decision: diana adjusts endpoint policy, carlos will update ingest role to allow the phealth CMK ARN, ivy will draft consent text for the customer, samir will brief AM on renewal risk and next steps. Agreed?

diana_netops: Adjusting endpoint now. Adding explicit allow for arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/CloudTrailDelivery and the s3:PutObject action. Will also add a policy statement to allow kms:Encrypt for the delivery principal until we confirm.

carlos_se: I'll prepare an IAM change for redwood-audit-ingest role: add kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey permissions for the specific CMK ARN (arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:444455556666:key/abcd-ef01-2345). Pushing to staging for tests.

ivy_security: Draft consent message: "Redwood will request permission to reference your KMS key ARN from its ingest role to enable audit ingestion. No alias will be created. This allows Redwood to decrypt only for ingestion and logs will show usage. Rotation policies remain controlled by PolarisHealth." Will send to PolarisHealth legal/CISO for sign-off.

samir_cs: I'll message AM + Renewal owner: "Status: endpoint policy + KMS ARN update in progress. Risk: blocked audit evidence. ETA: 2h for verification; mitigations: temporary retained snapshots, daily syncs, enablement doc to follow."

diana_netops: Endpoint update done. Test PUT using CloudTrail delivery principal returned 200 for s3://polaris-audit/redwood/2026/03/21/0001.json. Posting head-object: {Key: "redwood/2026/03/21/0001.json", Size: 2048}.

carlos_se: Staging KMS allow added. Test decrypt from redwood-audit-ingest succeeded. Will request ivy sign-off before prod apply.

ivy_security: Confirmed minimal policy looks good. Ensure condition restricting kms:ViaService or kms:CallerAccount is present. Also attach change-control CS-4620 and request customer consent email thread.

ops-bot: Action logged: endpoint-policy=true by diana_netops at 2026-03-21T18:05:00Z

maya_k: Once prod changes are applied, we need one person to run verification checklist: 1) CloudTrail deliveries hitting redwood prefix, 2) Ingest can decrypt and process file, 3) CloudTrail events captured for the KMS usage and endpoint change. Who can own?

diana_netops: I'll verify delivery and provide S3 object samples.

carlos_se: I'll verify decrypts and post CloudTrail KMS event IDs.

ivy_security: I'll collect audit evidence and upload to CS ticket (CS-4620). Also prepping the enablement note for PolarisHealth: step-by-step for key rotation, validating ingress, and how to revoke access in emergency. ETA 18h.

samir_cs: Posted external message to PolarisHealth CSM + CISO: "We are applying KMS ARN update and endpoint policy fixes now. Please reply to CS-4620 with explicit consent for our IAM change. Verification window: 60min after prod apply."

ops-bot: Prod KMS permission applied by carlos_se at 2026-03-21T18:22:05Z

diana_netops: Verified objects arriving in target prefix and access logs show redwood-ingest role. Sample CloudTrail EventID: 3f5a1b2c-.... Posting snippet in ticket.

carlos_se: KMS usage event IDs: kms-evt-7890 and kms-evt-7891 — decrypts succeeded.

maya_k: Excellent. Renewal update: samir, please set renewal status to "at-risk->monitoring" and attach CS-4620 evidence. Also schedule 1:1 enablement with PolarisHealth week after next.

samir_cs: Done. Renewal flagged as monitoring; scheduled enablement on 2026-04-05. Closing loop — will follow up after Ivy's enablement doc is posted."
